experiment: Windows Vulkan Add(x,x)/Neg/Add constrained completion-observer diagnostic
interpretation: Current BlockingPool path is below the root-direct-wait control in both independent-case process medians. This does not establish statistical significance, equivalence, a production speedup or the old Abs G09 ranking.

machine.process_affinity: 0x55, logical CPUs 0,2,4,6; no P/E or physical-core inference

workload.input: 4194304 F32 values, original x[j]=(j%101-50)*0.125, residual1.25; one invocation slot.
workload.independent: CPU Native Add(x,x) and resident Vulkan Neg(1.25), then CPU Native Add joining both. Exact oracle=(x+x)-1.25.
workload.serial: CPU Native Add(x,x) -> Vulkan Neg -> CPU Native Add with residual1.25. Exact oracle=1.25-(x+x).
workload.scope_change: Original Abs is replaced in both arms because explicit Native rejects dense F32 Abs. Native also rejects F32 Neg; ATen CPU deliberately declines dense basic math. This is a different current workload, not a repaired old Abs benchmark or a cross-platform rank.

boundary.timed: Python ctypes replay: bind, prepare_replay, submit, checked wait and output scalar read/check, destroy every view/ResultLease/OwnedResult, then Scheduler.drain before return.
boundary.excluded: Cold runtime/Context/Graph preparation, first replay, 8 warmups, all-element oracles before/after, resource/thread snapshots, close/destroy and process-exit cleanup.
boundary.control: Only one pending original native Completion, no ready native stage and no pool-owned handle: root unlocks monitor and directly waits the same owner. Original pool job start/stop/destroy, leases, checked finish and retirement remain.
boundary.control_limit: Waiting on Scheduler root changes Scheduler availability. This is a same-owner/explicit-resource causal intervention, not a directly substitutable production optimization or theoretical minimum native cost.
boundary.counters: Smoke macros ON; formal macros OFF in both arms. The formal current code excludes the diagnostic conditional entirely. Serial does not enter the modified parallel-lane branch.

resources.explicit: Both 2 Scheduler workers, BlockingPool cap2/keepalive10s, measured pool live1/retained handles1 throughout each timed block; ATen intra/inter-op1 set once cold and observed1/1. No extra observer thread.
resources.actual_os_threads: First three formal processes have 19; last current process18. GetThreadDescription returned empty names. Full before/after/creation/CPU-time snapshots retained; extra thread role is unknown, not asserted to be a driver thread.
resources.cpu_time_limit: GetThreadTimes values use 100 ns units but observed CPU accounting steps are coarse. These bracketed snapshots do not provide per-stage costs, instantaneous runnable-thread counts or latency timer resolution.

method.numeric: Both final smoke and all formal full exact all-element oracles pass before and after timing, plus every timed scalar check.

reuse.fresh: vulkan_lowering.cc, vulkan_batch.cc, hybrid compile.cc, each-arm invocation.cc/facade.cc only.
reuse.ggml: Only locked GPU ggml456172 core used; no CPU ggml core/library linked. Native CPU provider has existing Torch imports; no Torch tensor math selected for F32 Add.
reuse.limit: Both share cached common foundation and native Vulkan libraries; not a complete current-HEAD rebuild. No new vendor, dependency download, SDK/runtime staging or copying.
